<!-- pr-reviewer: 5d8b71e22c9060db36ebb3813a285d89d10fe319 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one small, mechanical item: the #926 doosan-dnm `probe` golden the issue names as its pin is still listed as a known bug). The post fix itself looks correct.

Reviewed at 5d8b71e (safety floor: changes posted G-code). Trial-merged with upstream main 29fb684: clean, no conflicts. The PR's own diff against main is the single top commit (7 posts, new suite, decision file).

## What looks good
- All seven mill posts gate the coolant on the existing #523/#574 probe test (`spindleWait && !(sRpm > 0)`, computed before `spindleWait` is cleared): fanuc.cps:459, haas.cps:357, mazak.cps:348, sinumerik.cps:369, heidenhain.cps:314, doosan-dnm.cps:597 (new `touchProbe`, :560), carvera.cps:257. Tormach already had the gate. A cutting section (rpm > 0) takes the unchanged `coolantFor(coolantAsk)` path, so no real cutting section loses coolant; the control test `a_cutting_section_still_starts_its_coolant` pins that.
- Fix is in the posts, not the stream, with the reasoning recorded in `docs/decisions/995-probe-no-coolant.md`. No goldens move (every committed probe golden is machine-less; I confirmed no golden diff in the PR).
- No process files, build.rs, deps, scripts, snapshots or CHANGELOG touched; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #995`. No PathPilot Hub or other hands-on check is requested by the PR or issue #995.

## Local results (merged with main, debug, sccache)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | green: post suites (29 binaries incl. fanuc_post, probe_dialects, probe_guard, probe_spindle, probe_spindle_stop, inverted_probe, script_* for carvera/doosan-dnm/fanuc/haas/heidenhain/mazak/sinumerik) and app suites (44 incl. coolant, coolant_air, coolant_followups, conformance, posting, carvera_post, probe_op, probe_no_coolant) |
| app `probe_no_coolant` | 5 passed |
| app `golden_cl`, `tormach_post` | 26 passed (together with probe_no_coolant) |
| post `recorded_streams`, `probe_tormach`, `script_tormach` | 10 / 7 / 12 passed (one 11-test suite also green) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Requested before merge
1. `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs:46-48`: #1002 has merged, so `KNOWN_BUGS` still lists `("doosan-dnm.cps", "probe", 995)` and that case has no golden. The PR body and decision file say whichever of #1002/#1034 merges second drops the entry and records the golden without M8/M9, and issue #995's "Done means" names that golden as the pin. Please remove the entry (and its comment) and record the golden with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` after reading it: it must contain no M8/M9 and the other cases' goldens must be unchanged. Then re-run `recorded_streams` and `script_doosan_dnm`.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Dropping (not refusing) an explicit Mist/Air/Through-tool ask on a probe op is a recorded decision for the maintainer to overrule; I agree with it.
- doosan-dnm still writes no M5 before a probe's first move; the PR says it is filed separately.
- The PR is also labelled with no state label yet; mergeability is clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
